|rad3oui = |rad3_ant_conn = U.FL |rad3txchains = 2 |rad3rxchains = 2 |rad3sstreams = 2 |rad3stand = IEEE 802.11a/n/ac |rad3ac = 867 |nqam3 = 400 |rad3n = 300 |rad3a = 54 |rad3freq = 5 }}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "2976564102" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. {{FCC ST|03/15/2018|}} * Web GUI: http://orbilogin.com Included in kits: *[https://www.netgear.com/orbi/rbk22.aspx Orbi WiFi System (RBK22)] AC2200: :One (1x) [[Netgear Orbi Router (RBR20)]] :One (1x) [[Netgear Orbi Satellite (RBS20)]] *[https://www.netgear.com/orbi/rbk44.aspx Orbi WiFi System (RBK44)] AC2200: :One (1x) [[Netgear Orbi Router (RBR40)]] :Three (3x) [[Netgear Orbi Satellite (RBS20)]] ===FCC Info=== Although the datasheet claims that the device contains a quad-core 710MHz, :the IPQ4019 pictured in FCC photos is believed to operate at 716MHz. Two different boards with the same layout are pictured in the FCC internal photos. :One has [[Winbond]] flash and RAM but the spot for the BT chip, the second [[Winbond]] :flash, and the digital temperature sensor are unpopulated while the other board :has a larger [[Nanya]] RAM chip and includes the extra flash and temperature sensor. The board with the extra chips is probably just the ''[[Netgear Orbi Satellite (RBS20)|Gen1]]'' device since FCC documents :for this ''Gen2'' model say that Bluetooth functionality will be removed. ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/netgear/netgear_rbs20 |wikipage = |forumpage = |github = |target = ipq40xx |subtarget = generic |arch = arm_cortex-a7_neon-vfpv4 |support_commit_id = 0db1b11073af0282282e3c825a0498c19c837383 |support_started_version = 25.12.0 |current_supported_version = 25.12.1 |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = Qualcomm Atheros QCA8072 |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Qualcomm IPQ4019, Qualcomm Atheros QCA9886 |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = GUI generic, see git-commit |inst_comment = |rec_method = see git-commit |rec_comment = nmrpflash works |comment = }} {{SCollapse | git • >> | 
ipq40xx: add support for Netgear RBS20
This device has only half the flash and ram of the RBR20. It also has
two lan ports instead of wan and lan.

Hardware
--------
SOC:    Qualcomm IPQ4019
FLASH:  128MB (Winbond W29N01HVSINF)
RAM:    256MB (Winbond W632GU6MB-12)
WIFI:   Qualcomm IPQ4019
        Qualcomm Atheros QCA9886
ETH:    2x LAN
LED:    5 (4 RGB at top, 1 RG at back)
BTN:    WPS, Reset
UART:   115200 8N1 (dotted Pin = VCC) VCC-TX-RX-GND

MAC addresses
-------------
LAN     Label MAC (stored in boarddata1 offset 0x0)
2.4G    LAN
5GLow   LAN + 3 (stored in boarddata1 offset 0xc)
5GUpper LAN + 2 (stored in boarddata1 offset 0x12)

Installation
------------
Either use the vendor ui upgrade method or nmrpflash to install the
factory image.
